subject: Great experience at the Suzhou Industrial Park store
body:
Hi there,

I just wanted to write in about the help I got at your Suzhou Industrial Park store last weekend. I went in looking for a new pair of running shoes and honestly wasn't sure what I needed. The staff member who helped me actually watched me walk and asked about my usual routes before suggesting anything, which I appreciated. I ended up with a pair that felt right from the first run, and my knees have been much happier on longer distances. It's rare to get that kind of attention without feeling pressured to buy the most expensive option. Please pass along my thanks to the team there.

Best,
Alex
